the crack in the turbine blade is caused by the stress concentration at the root of the turbine blade, the stress concentration is caused by the design of the turbine blade.
The blade crack is caused by the blade shape design and blade material.
the crack in the turbine blade of the hydropower station is caused by the impact of the water flow on the blade, and the treatment of the crack is to replace the blade with a new one.

the design, analysis and optimization of the blade shape of axial flow adjustable-blade turbine.
the design of a novel and robust algorithm to estimate the number of cracks on turbine blades in hydropower stations.
the analysis and treatment of the cracks in the turbine blades, which will provide some references for the similar problems in the future.
